stepNotes.1: The barrel exposes shared card/input UI, a session-aware controller, and separate CodeMirror and Pierre renderer adapters.
stepNotes.2: React safely renders comment text, while persisted draft IDs cross into an unescaped Pierre query selector and create a local malformed-state failure edge.
stepNotes.3: Save normalization is sound, but edit state can survive a session or file identity change and silently target an absent draft in the new bucket.
stepNotes.4: Draft transforms are linear, Pierre retries stop after twelve frames, and observer/listener cleanup is paired; whole-map store subscription is the main scaling advisory.
stepNotes.5: Persistence, range adaptation, editor placement, annotation metadata, and third-party portal behavior have distinct owners with consistent side conversion.
stepNotes.6: Focus and pointer races are guarded, but the icon-only menu trigger and placeholder-only textarea need explicit translated accessible names.
stepNotes.7: Four store tests and the UI typecheck pass, while controller state changes, widget layout, portal lookup, malformed IDs, and accessibility remain directly untested.
stepNotes.8: The empty ledger has no Critical item; this review notes one Medium stale-context candidate and two Low robustness/accessibility issues.
stepNotes.9: The focused Vitest file passed all four cases and the UI TypeScript check completed without errors; no Critical confirmation file was warranted.
